newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Argentine general due in Cyprus to head U.N. force.
newsitem.headline: Argentine general due in Cyprus to head U.N. force.

text.p: Argentine Major-General Evergisto Arturo De Vergara arrives in Cyprus on Saturday to take up duties as commander of the United Nations peacekeeping force on the island, a U.N. official said on Friday.
Vergara, 51, is to succeed Brigadier-General Ahti Toimi Paavali Vartianen of Finland on February 28. Vartianen is returning to general headquarters of the Finnish armed forces.
The 1,200-strong United Nations Peacekeeping Force in Cyprus (UNFICYP) was first deployed on the island in 1964 after sporadic intercommunal violence between Greek and Turkish Cypriots.

It now guards a 180-km (110-mile) ceasefire line which has split the island in two after Turkey invaded the northern third of Cyprus in 1974 following a Greek Cypriot coup engineered by the military then ruling Greece.
